strategies.description: Coordinate output tile aspect ratio and CTA traversal to improve A/B reuse

prompts.triton_h100: Inspect A/B physical strides, the current BM and BN output tile, CTA tile mapping (including GROUP_M if present), and the M/N tile counts. Choose a coordinated tile-aspect and/or CTA-order change based on the expected A/B revisit pattern. Check register and shared-memory constraints and preserve complete output coverage and one writer per output. If parent L2/DRAM counters are present, distinguish L2 TEX read requests, lookup hits and misses, and DRAM reads as aggregate evidence; do not assign saved bytes to A or B without evidence or equate L2 misses with DRAM sectors. Optimize measured CUDA-event latency, not DRAM traffic alone, and do not assume that a particular tile shape always wins.
